scenes.vo: Do you need an app store app? Or a web app?

scenes.title: Start with a web app when
scenes.vo: Start with a web app when customers find you through search, use any device, and you want one update that's live for everyone.

scenes.title: Go mobile app for
scenes.vo: Choose a mobile app when you need the app stores, reliable push notifications, offline use, or deeper access to the phone.

scenes.title: One Flutter codebase
scenes.vo: Need both? We build with Flutter. One codebase for Android and iOS, sharing the same backend as your web app.

scenes.tagline: Web apps and Flutter apps on one shared backend
scenes.button: Pick your platform with us on WhatsApp
